cases.control: /vault/add: choose a .txt file as the photo
cases.expected: a visible message that the file is not an image
cases.actual: alert="That scan file is not an image."; crop step opened=false

cases.control: /vault/add: Use Full Photo in the crop step
cases.expected: accepts the whole photo and closes the step; Identify with AI is available
cases.actual: crop step still open=false; Identify offered=true

cases.control: /vault/add: Identify with AI when the AI call is refused (simulated by the harness)
cases.expected: a visible message that identify failed and the form can be filled by hand; typed name kept
cases.actual: alert="Image identify failed (intercepted by audit). Fill in the details by hand, or try again."; name kept=true; AI requests refused=1

cases.expected: a visible message (the lookup is switched off), not silence
cases.actual: alert="PSA cert lookup is unavailable right now, so the cert number was not looked up. It is still saved with the item."

cases.expected: refused when chosen with a plain message; no photo tile
cases.actual: message="\"rb28-notes.txt\" is not a photo. Choose a JPEG, PNG or similar image."; photo tiles=0

cases.expected: refused when chosen with a plain message; no photo tile
cases.actual: message="\"rb28-doc.pdf\" is not a photo. Choose a JPEG, PNG or similar image."; photo tiles=0

cases.expected: refused when chosen with a plain message; no photo tile
cases.actual: message="\"rb28-bad.png\" couldn't be read as a photo. Choose a different image."; photo tiles=0

cases.control: /capture: Use Full Photo in the crop step (native camera hand-off)
cases.expected: accepts the whole photo: the step closes and the photo is attached

cases.control: /capture: press and drag the second thumbnail onto the first with a mouse
cases.expected: the dragged photo becomes the cover (the order swaps)

cases.control: /vault/quick: the camera cannot start (no camera in this browser)
cases.expected: the screen says the camera is unavailable and why
cases.actual: message="Camera access is blocked for this site. Allow the camera in your browser settings, then reopen Quick Add."

cases.control: /vault/quick: Identify 2 with AI when the AI call is refused (simulated by the harness)
cases.expected: the sheet says how many could not be identified and to fill them in by hand; no camera warning when the camera works
cases.actual: camera warning shown=false; sheet: 2 of 2 couldn't be identified.; AI requests refused=2

cases.control: /vault/bulk: a card's own 'Scan with AI' when the allowance cannot be read
cases.expected: clickable, and says the allowance could not be checked; no AI call
